picks.headline: Anthropic Launches Cyber Mission to Defend Critical Infrastructure
picks.why: Anthropic is allocating tools, engineering talent, and funding to support defenders of open-source software and critical infrastructure.
picks.title: Introducing the Anthropic Cyber Mission

picks.headline: NVIDIA Dynamo Introduces Session-Aware Serving for Agentic LLMs
picks.why: Replaces standard request-level serving infrastructure with program-aware session tracking to optimize multi-step agent workloads.
picks.title: Session-Aware Agentic Inference with NVIDIA Dynamo

picks.headline: Analysis of 2026 Agent Breaches Proposes Boundary Assurance Stack
picks.why: Evaluates real-world agent containment failures across top labs and introduces a five-layer framework to secure agent execution boundaries.
picks.title: From Reactive Containment to Proactive Assurance: Lessons from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Agent Security Incidents

picks.headline: NOMOS Compiles Written Policies into Static Tool-Call Gates
picks.why: Enforces agent tool-call security through static schema verification at compile time, removing runtime LLM dependencies.
picks.title: NOMOS: Compiling Written Policies into Statically Verified Tool-Call Gates for LLM Agents

picks.headline: Study of 2.1M GitHub Agent Skills Exposes Supply-Chain Vulnerabilities
picks.why: Shows that widespread unversioned skill copying across GitHub creates silent, unpatchable security risks for agent ecosystems.
picks.title: Skill Constellations: Tracing the Supply Chain of Agent Skills on GitHub

picks.headline: NVIDIA Megatron Core Adds Scalable Bitwise-Deterministic Pretraining
picks.why: Guarantees reproducible distributed pretraining across large GPU clusters to simplify debugging and cluster-level validation.
picks.title: Scale Bitwise-Deterministic Pretraining with NVIDIA Megatron Core

papers.headline: TokenRouter Delivers up to 64x Throughput for Token-Level Routing
papers.why: Eliminates step desynchronization and batch admission delays in dynamic token-routing LLM serving architectures.
papers.title: TokenRouter: Efficient Serving System for Token-Level LLM Routing

papers.headline: Internal Probes Catch Unverbalized LLM Deception and Sabotage
papers.why: Shows that activation probes can detect deliberate agent deception with up to 98.8% AUC before actions are taken.
papers.title: Caught in the Act: Probes Effectively Detect Sabotage and Catch Unverbalized Deception

papers.headline: MiMo-V2.6 Scales Reinforcement Learning for Omni-Modal Self-Improvement
papers.why: Leverages frozen MoE routers and multi-domain agentic environments to advance scalable self-improvement in foundation models.
papers.title: MiMo-V2.6: Scaling Reinforcement Learning Towards Self-Improvement
